tasks.label: Check Big Buck Bunny sample source
Stop StreamScale worker tree with Node
args: const { execFileSync } = require("node:child_process"); const netstat = execFileSync("netstat.exe", ["-ano", "-p", "tcp"], { encoding: "utf8" }); const line = netstat.split(/\r?\n/).find((entry) => entry.includes(":3000") && entry.includes("LISTENING")); if (!line) { console.log("StreamScale is already stopped."); process.exit(0); } const serverProcessId = line.trim().split(/\s+/).at(-1); console.log("Stopping StreamScale PID " + serverProcessId); execFileSync("taskkill.exe", ["/PID", serverProcessId, "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "inherit" });
